fields.description: One row per Deal stage. A stage with no row here is not configured, and the house default in auraos/lib/forecast.py governs it - which is the only way to tell "the founder means 0" from "nobody has said yet", because Lost is legitimately 0.
fields.label: Stage
fields.options:
Brief Received
De-brief
Breakdown
Quote Sent
Negotiation
Won
Lost

fields.description: How much of this deal's value the forecast counts. Whole percent: a win probability finer than one point is false precision on a guess. Won is 100 and Lost is 0, but neither contributes - a won deal is a job, and its milestones are already receivables.
fields.label: Win Probability %

fields.description: Days from today to the month a deal at this stage is expected to bill in. Counted from today, not from the day the deal entered the stage: a deal that has been sitting does not bill sooner for having waited.
fields.label: Lead Time (days)
